desc:
🏋️‍♂️ Welcome to Ultra Lifting Simulator 🏋️‍♀️

🏆 Compete on multiple leaderboards and prove that you are the best.
💪 Train hard to build muscle, sell it for coins, and unlock powerful new weights.
🦾 Combine various elements to transform your body and gain even more muscle mass.
🔥 Unlock divine abilities like Hercules and Ares for massive damage boosts.
🩸 Push past your limits with bloodlines to gain HP/DMG multipliers and transformations.
💎 Earn diamonds every minute, with the amount increasing based on your body.
🐦‍🔥 Forge your body alongside the gods and through the ages to unlock extreme power!

💪 x60000 Muscle
🩸 x20 Bloodline
🪽 x20 Fame
🍀 x25 Luck
